scope: Historical planning-only mechanism diagnostic. Freeze remotely before any of the 24 real fits execute.
execution_order: version, task, head, seed; six branches in the exact declared order

proposal.reference: Original complete warmup plus 32 exact full-batch Adam updates with zero parameter intervention.
proposal.action_box: Every coordinate of u is in [-4/sqrt(p),4/sqrt(p)]; physical increment is dt*u after Adam.
proposal.local_problem: Linearized weighted terminal loss plus (dt*rho/2)*sum(u^2), solved by coordinate clipping with no old hard constraint.
proposal.myopic_scope: Only the first action is free and uses the one-step loss gradient. This is not the historical V7 constrained-and-repaired myopic policy.
proposal.common_scope: The Full32 one-action and three eight-action proposals all use the same step-32 endpoint, weights, price and zero-control continuation.
proposal.no_adaptation: No safety filter, line search, selection labels, Full-risk fallback, or outcome-dependent replacement action. All 32 actual updates run even if old bounds are violated.

attribution.endpoint: Compare myopic_h1_zero_tail with full32_one_action: same one free action and actual J32 score, different proposal endpoint.
attribution.action_freedom: Compare full32_one_action with full32_eight_actions: same terminal objective and Full tangent model, different number of free actions.
attribution.forecast: Compare Full, field and Loss2 maps on every identical actual action sequence, reporting panel and priced-J32 actual-minus-tangent errors.
attribution.nonlinear: A better tangent objective need not improve true J32; retain both values and separate terminal risk from physical intervention effort.
attribution.generalization: Planning-panel results cannot identify why an independently sampled future outcome worsened, establish population retention, or satisfy the original scientific gate.

field_scope: The exact local finite-window field shrinks 264 to 8 coordinates, exceeding the 108/156-dimensional optimizer state at its start. Full state supplies all coefficients; no compactness or speed claim.
retention_record: Four original warmup old-panel anchors; save every per-step loss and violation, initial excess, terminal excess, complete state digest and receipt. Violations never abort this unguarded diagnostic.
failure_record: All 144 slots retained. Exceptions remain explicit unavailable/error outcomes; no zero-action substitution and no claim of global infeasibility.
cost_scope: Charge shared reference and coefficient preparation separately, then all six actual rollouts and runner work. This shared-preparation diagnostic is not a per-policy CPU<=3 gate benchmark.
freeze_contract: The host publishes this protocol with status FROZEN and the executed source closure, then supplies exact protocol/source hashes and source commit to the runner. Hashes are local identity commitments, not independent authentication.
